articles.summary: To substantiate an environmental claim under the EU's new rules, you need product-level emissions data built from primary activity data and supplier-specific emission factors, calculated on a recognised method such as ISO 14067, and traceable from the claim on the label back to the records behind it. Spend-based estimates and company-wide averages do not meet that bar.
articles.title: What Emissions Data Do You Need to Substantiate an Environmental Claim Under the New EU Rules?
